newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-FONTANA RELEGATED TO BACK OF GRID.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FONTANA RELEGATED TO BACK OF GRID.

text.p: Argentine Norberto Fontana must start Sunday's British Grand Prix from the back of the 22-car grid after his qualifying times were disallowed on Saturday.
Fontana, who made his debut for Sauber in the French Grand Prix two weeks ago, had set the 14th best time but race stewards said he broke the rules when he missed a weight check.
Checks take place during all practice and qualifying sessions, with drivers chosen at random to ensure their cars conform to the regulations.
